platemap.request: Set up PCR reactions for 8 DNA samples in a 96-well PCR plate. Each reaction is 20 ul of master mix plus 5 ul of sample. The master mix is in a 1.5 ml tube and the samples are in 1.5 ml tubes.

variants.name: 8 reactions free placement
variants.why: the request does not specify wells; placement left to protocol writer

notes: the request does not say which wells; free placement chosen

steps.reasoning: We need create plate map. 8 samples, likely placed anywhere. No pinned wells. One variant with free group containing 8 members: each member has master_mix 20, sample_i 5. Need define liquids: master_mix (reagent), sample_{i} indexed 8. Destination auto. Notes about placement choice. Let's craft.
steps.arguments: {"platemap": {"liquids": [{"name": "master_mix", "role": "reagent", "bind": "name", "pattern": "(?i)master\\s*mix|mastermix"}, {"name": "sample_{i}", "role": "sample", "bind": "indexed", "pattern": "(?i)(?:sample|dna|template)\\D{0,12}?(\\d+)", "count": 8, "index": "number"}], "destination": {"select": "auto"}, "variants": [{"name": "8 reactions free placement", "why": "the request does not specify wells; placement left to protocol writer", "pinned": {}, "groups": [{"name": "reactions", "members": [{"master_mix": 20, "sample_1": 5}, {"master_mix": 20, "sample_2": 5}, {"master_mix": 20, "sample_3": 5}, {"master_mix": 20, "sample_4": 5}, {"master_mix": 20, "sample_5": 5}, {"master_mix": 20, "sample_6": 5}, {"master_mix": 20, "sample_7": 5}, {"master_mix": 20, "sample_8": 5}], "within": null, "position": "free", "order_hint": "index"}]}], "discard_intended": [], "notes": ["the request does not say which wells; free placement chosen"]}}
